mapper.select: SELECT sp.* FROM sys_permission sp LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission srp ON srp.permission_id = sp.id WHERE srp.role_id = #{roleId} AND sp.status = 1

SELECT sp.* FROM sys_permission sp LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission srp ON srp.permission_id = sp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON sur.role_id = srp.role_id WHERE sur.user_id = #{userId} AND sp.status = 1
